Read an HDF5 file with a data matrix

Source: R/io-hdf.R
read_hdf.Rd

read_hdf() reads the dataset key of an HDF5 (.h5) file into the X of an AnnData() object, as Python's read_hdf(). If the file also has the datasets row_names and col_names they become the obs and var names.

Usage

read_hdf(filename, key)

Arguments

filename

A path to the HDF5 file.

key

The name of the dataset holding the matrix. An empty string is an error that lists the datasets in the file.

Value

An AnnData() object.

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")
rhdf5::h5createFile(path)
rhdf5::h5write(matrix(c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5), 2), path, "data")
read_hdf(path, "data")
#> AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 2 × 2
#>     layers: None (.X)
